families.axis: a thing handled wrongly → a person wholly cast as the victim of it
families._definition: used incorrectly or carelessly or for an improper purpose

members.tone: The flattest of these - it faults the handling, whether careless or deliberate, without yet accusing anyone of cruelty.
members._gloss: used incorrectly or carelessly or for an improper purpose

members.tone: Harder than *misused* because excess joins impropriety - the fault lies in how much as well as how, drugs squarely included.
members._gloss: used improperly or excessively especially drugs

members.tone: Cold and calculating beside *ill-used* - it implies someone drew profit from the person, and names the gain rather than the hurt.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

members.tone: Formal and plain-spoken - a verdict that a wrong was done, without *exploited*'s implication that anyone gained by it.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

members.tone: Informal, and the only one of these that shows the wrong from the sufferer's side - the person is imposed on and visibly feels it, where *ill-used* and *exploited* merely report what was done to them.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

members.tone: Bare and cutting - the unmodified participle reduces the person to an instrument, saying far less than *exploited* and landing colder for it.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

members.tone: The strongest of the set - it does not merely report the wrong but makes the person's whole standing consist in having suffered it.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

members.tone: British spelling of *victimized*, and it carries the same total verdict - the person defined by the wrong rather than merely subjected to it.
members._gloss: (of persons) taken advantage of

families.axis: a rescue merely absent → damnation pronounced and the ruin complete
families._definition: spiritually or physically doomed or destroyed

members.tone: The softest of these condemnations - it states the doom as a settled condition without naming who or what condemned, where *damned* pronounces the sentence.
members._gloss: spiritually or physically doomed or destroyed

members.tone: Lays the peril on the subject from outside, as something worked upon them, where *unsaved* reports only a lack.
members._gloss: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

members.tone: The verdict pronounced outright, naming the punishment rather than circling it - heavier than *doomed*, which only fixes the outcome.
members._gloss: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

members.tone: Settles the peril as fate already fixed, condemning without a condemner, where *cursed* implies something laid it on.
members._gloss: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

members.tone: Formal and abstract - an account left unsettled rather than a sentence passed, so it lands well short of *damned*.
members._gloss: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

members.tone: The flattest way to state the danger, a bare absence of rescue where *damned* is an active condemnation.
members._gloss: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell

members.tone: Absolute - the wreck, physical or moral, is already complete, where *doomed* leaves it still ahead.
members._gloss: destroyed physically or morally

members.tone: Keeps the aftermath in view, something once whole now spoiled, a shade less final than *destroyed*.
members._gloss: destroyed physically or morally

families.axis: plain absence of activity → slackness treated as a fault
families._definition: lacking activity; lying idle or unused

members.tone: The flat, unmarked term for the state, reporting that nothing is going on without suggesting anything is wrong with that.
members._gloss: lacking activity; lying idle or unused

members.tone: States a closure as a plain condition — nothing is being put on — where *dead* would make the emptiness itself the verdict.
members._gloss: not giving performances; closed

members.tone: The absolute form: activity is not merely reduced but gone, which is what carries it past *dull*.
members._gloss: devoid of activity

members.tone: Hears the lack of briskness as a flatness worth complaining about, where *slow* only reports the rate.
members._gloss: (of business) not active or brisk

members.tone: The mildest of the three, measuring the pace of trade rather than passing judgement on it as *sluggish* does.
members._gloss: (of business) not active or brisk

members.tone: Adds torpor to the slackness, making the absence of brisk trade sound like something too heavy to move.
members._gloss: (of business) not active or brisk

members.tone: Puts a hint of waste on the disuse — something capable of working and sitting there instead — which *unused* does not.
members._gloss: not in active use

members.tone: Purely factual: it records that the thing is not in use and stops, with none of the reproach in *idle*.
members._gloss: not in active use

members.tone: Names the cause along with the standstill, so it attributes rather than evaluates the stoppage.
members._gloss: closed or immobilized by a strike

families.axis: not currently moving → held absolutely immobile
families._definition: not in motion

members.tone: The bare denial - it states only that motion is absent, with none of the held-in-place force of *fixed*.
members._gloss: not in motion

members.tone: More observational than *nonmoving*, describing a thing seen not to move rather than classifying it as one that does not.
members._gloss: not in motion

members.tone: On this sense it reports only that a thing is not physically moving, carrying none of the completeness of *motionless*.
members._gloss: not in physical motion

members.tone: Complete and picture-like - a body wholly without movement, where *inactive* merely records that none is occurring.
members._gloss: not in physical motion

members.tone: Cool and near-technical, framing stillness as a standing condition of the thing rather than a moment of it as *motionless* does.
members._gloss: not in physical motion

members.tone: The plainest and calmest member - stillness as quiet, not as the arrest that *frozen* implies.
members._gloss: not in physical motion

members.tone: Carries its cause with it - the wind has failed, so the stillness is suffered rather than held, which plain *motionless* leaves open.
members._gloss: rendered motionless for lack of wind

members.tone: Stillness with something holding it there - not merely unmoving but pinned, which *still* never implies.
members._gloss: fixed and unmoving

members.tone: Blunter and more settled than *fixed*, suggesting a position taken and no longer open to adjustment.
members._gloss: fixed and unmoving

members.tone: Adds stiffness to the fixity - it does not move because it will not bend, where *fixed* says only that it is held.
members._gloss: fixed and unmoving

members.tone: The stillness of a sudden stop - motion arrested mid-course rather than never begun, unlike *stationary*.
members._gloss: absolutely still

members.tone: Stillness as being held fast from below - immovable rather than simply halted like *frozen*.
members._gloss: absolutely still

members.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - total, unqualified stillness, without the sense of arrest in *frozen*.
members._gloss: absolutely still

members.tone: Names an incapacity rather than a state - the thing cannot move or push back, which *motionless* never claims.
members._gloss: unable to move or resist motion

members.tone: Stillness read as exposure - it puts a target on whatever it describes, which no other member of the family does.
members._gloss: not moving and therefore easy to attack

members.tone: Neutral and positional - stillness as where a thing stands, not something done to it as in *becalmed*.
members._gloss: standing still

families.axis: flat statement of rank → superiority worn as a manner
families._definition: of or characteristic of high rank or importance

members.tone: The family's plain baseline - it states high rank or importance and leaves the verdict to the reader, where *eminent* already admires.
members._gloss: of or characteristic of high rank or importance

members.tone: The lightest of the condescension words - superiority worn as a knowing manner rather than pressed on anyone, though it is still looking down.
members._gloss: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension

members.tone: Names the fault flatly: a manner that puts the other person below, without the play in *arch*.
members._gloss: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension

members.tone: The most accusing word for the same attitude - it makes the condescension something done to someone, and expects the reader to object.
members._gloss: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension

members.tone: The British spelling of *patronizing*, and it gives up none of the reproach.
members._gloss: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension

members.tone: Approving - the height is in quality as much as position, where *high-ranking* only marks the rung.
members._gloss: standing above others in quality or position

members.tone: The barest way to say the same standing - elevation without the honour *eminent* confers.
members._gloss: standing above others in quality or position

members.tone: Puts the subject at the front of the field, and does it in a level, unceremonious voice beside *preeminent*.
members._gloss: greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement

members.tone: The strongest praise here - greatness set far enough above the rest that comparison stops mattering.
members._gloss: greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement

members.tone: Neutral placement: it states elevation in rank or importance and passes no judgement on whoever occupies it.
members._gloss: at an elevated level in rank or importance

members.tone: Blunter than *eminent* - elevation as a plain fact of rank, with none of the lustre.
members._gloss: at an elevated level in rank or importance

members.tone: The most colourless of the three - elevation reduced to a tier, with no suggestion of merit.
members._gloss: at an elevated level in rank or importance

members.tone: Awed rather than merely approving - the superiority sits in the bearing, and it lifts the subject clear of ordinary concerns.
members._gloss: majestic in manner or bearing; superior to mundane matters

members.tone: Cooler and more remote than *majestic* - the loftiness reads as untouched by mundane things rather than warmly grand.
members._gloss: majestic in manner or bearing; superior to mundane matters

members.tone: Technical and relational - it fixes one thing above another in an order and carries neither warmth nor reproach.
members._gloss: of higher rank or status or value

members.tone: The shortest term here for standing above, registering the position without any of the admiration in *eminent*.
members._gloss: superior in rank or accomplishment

families.axis: damage named with contempt → damage merely recorded
families._definition: harmed or injured or spoiled

members.tone: The family's flat baseline: harm has occurred, and the word passes no verdict on the state it left, where *dilapidated* passes little else.
members._gloss: harmed or injured or spoiled

members.tone: Puts the cause inside the word - blows and hard usage - where *damaged* leaves the cause blank.
members._gloss: damaged by blows or hard usage

members.tone: Informal where *battered* is neutral in register, treating the same hard usage as something to shrug at rather than record.
members._gloss: damaged by blows or hard usage

members.tone: The fuller form of *beat-up*, equally informal, with a little more of the beating still audible in it.
members._gloss: damaged by blows or hard usage

members.tone: Wears the deplorable condition on the surface, making it look pitiable rather than shameful, where *derelict* makes it a reproach.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: Names the deplorable state as something that has given way, plainer and more mechanical than *tatterdemalion*.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: Condemning rather than descriptive - the deplorable state reads as neglect that was allowed to happen, where *dented* is only a fact about a shape.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: The formal word for the deplorable state, presenting it as advanced and cumulative decay rather than the single mishap *dented* records.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: Adds precariousness to the deplorable state - the thing is not merely poor but barely holding together, which *damaged* never implies.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: The most ornate word in this set, and the flourish makes the contempt sound almost relished beside plain *broken-down*.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: Plain-spoken where *tatterdemalion* is ornate, and it leaves the deplorable state one shove from collapse.
members._gloss: in deplorable condition

members.tone: Damage as deformation rather than breakage: the shape has gone but not necessarily the use, which *broken* denies outright.
members._gloss: of metal e.g.

members.tone: Deformation taken across the whole of a thing rather than along one line, so it reads as more thorough than *bent* while judging just as little.
members._gloss: of metal e.g.

members.tone: The most local of these three - one blow's worth of deformation, where *crumpled* takes the whole surface.
members._gloss: of metal e.g.

members.tone: A verdict on function alone: the thing does not work, and the word says nothing about how it got there, where *battered* says little else.
members._gloss: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)

members.tone: The informal substitute for *broken*, and the drop in register makes the same failure sound offhand rather than serious.
members._gloss: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)

families.axis: sound knowledge → worldly experience so complete nothing impresses
families._definition: having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire

members.tone: Praises worldly knowledge and refinement together, and it settles on the thing made for such a person as easily as on the person - a reach *urbane* lacks.
members._gloss: having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire

members.tone: The sophistication is charged to surfeit, which sours the praise - it marks a person as past being impressed where *worldly* only marks them as experienced.
members._gloss: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world

members.tone: Takes the versed-in-the-ways-of-the-world half of the sense straight, crediting the experience without the taint of excess *blase* carries.
members._gloss: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world

members.tone: The approval is for sound knowledge itself, with none of the social finish *sophisticated* insists on.
members._gloss: possessing sound knowledge

members.tone: Flatter than *intelligent* - the credit goes to what a person knows, not to anything in the knower.
members._gloss: possessing sound knowledge

members.tone: Praise for the finish, where the assurance is the visible surface and *refined* names the quality under it.
members._gloss: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experien

members.tone: Names the refinement itself rather than its display, so it praises without the suggestion of buffing that *polished* carries.
members._gloss: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experien

members.tone: The formal member, putting the weight on assured ease of manner rather than the surface shine *polished* names.
members._gloss: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experien

members.tone: Praises shrewdness rather than polish - it says a person cannot be fooled, which *urbane* never claims.
members._gloss: experienced in and wise to the ways of the world

families.axis: agreeable to your taste → an ideal of charmed, serene delight
families._definition: affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings

members.tone: The plain baseline of the family — pleasure that simply agrees with your taste, without the sweetness of *dulcet* or the height of *idyllic*.
members._gloss: affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings

members.tone: Turned on the weather, it rates a day at the top of enjoyable rather than merely *pleasant*.
members._gloss: (of weather) highly enjoyable

members.tone: Intensity turned soft — pleasantness taken to an extreme, but gently, where *gratifying* is emphatic.
members._gloss: extremely pleasant in a gentle way

members.tone: Unadorned approval of something that gives pleasure, carrying none of the sense of a want answered that *gratifying* adds.
members._gloss: affording satisfaction or pleasure

members.tone: Leans on the satisfaction half of the sense — pleasure that answers something, where *pleasurable* is pleasure for its own sake.
members._gloss: affording satisfaction or pleasure

members.tone: The most direct of these three: it names the pleasure itself, with none of the fulfilment *gratifying* implies.
members._gloss: affording satisfaction or pleasure

members.tone: Describes the thing that gives comfort rather than the person who feels thanks — a warm, easing approval beside the brighter *pleasurable*.
members._gloss: affording comfort or pleasure

members.tone: The strongest here — not merely pleasant but charmed, simple and serene, an ideal rather than a preference met.
members._gloss: suggestive of an idyll; charmingly simple and serene

members.tone: Routes approval through whichever sense is doing the work, and stays milder than the extremity of *dulcet*.
members._gloss: pleasant or agreeable to the senses

families.axis: merely having life in one → brimming with it
families._definition: having life or vigor or spirit

members.tone: Mild approval - credits a thing with visible vigor without claiming it brims over the way *lively* does.
members._gloss: having life or vigor or spirit

members.tone: Praise cut back to a bare condition - where *animated* shows the vigor off, this only asserts that it is there.
members._gloss: having life or vigor or spirit

members.tone: Flat and causal - the liveliness was put in from outside, so the word credits the doing rather than the thing.
members._gloss: made lively or spirited

members.tone: Frankly admiring where *enlivened* stays descriptive - the same imparted liveliness heard as a virtue rather than an effect.
members._gloss: made lively or spirited

members.tone: A step past *animated*'s mere possession of spirit to fullness of it, and the warmth rises with the quantity.
members._gloss: full of spirit; full of life

members.tone: Elevated in register - the same fullness of life as *lively*, but weightier, sounding like a force within rather than a liveliness on show.
members._gloss: full of spirit; full of life

members.tone: States the restoration plainly - fresh vigor recorded as an outcome, with none of the relief *revived* carries.
members._gloss: given fresh life or vigor or spirit

members.tone: Warmer than *reanimated* for the same return of vigor - the fresh life sounds like a recovery worth welcoming.
members._gloss: given fresh life or vigor or spirit

families.axis: a bare warrant that something passes → rightness actively inflicted as deserts
families._definition: used especially of what is legally or ethically right or proper or fitting

members._gloss: used especially of what is legally or ethically right or proper or fitting
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: The bar it sets is internal and low - the thing clears your conscience rather than being right in itself, so it approves far more faintly than *fitting*.
members._gloss: acceptable to your conscience

members.tone: Approval by exactness rather than permission - not merely allowable but precisely right, and it says so plainly where *meet* pronounces.
members._gloss: being precisely fitting and right

members.tone: The same verdict as *fitting* delivered as a formal pronouncement, weighty and a little ceremonious, so the rightness sounds handed down rather than observed.
members._gloss: being precisely fitting and right

members.tone: Cool and measured - what it approves is the fit between deserts and what is dealt out, not whatever it lands on, and it never softens the fact that the thing is inflicted.
members._gloss: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts

members.tone: Carries the same verdict as *retributive* with more machinery in the mouth, sounding like the working of paying back rather than the principle behind it.
members._gloss: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts

members.tone: Points at the rightness rather than the sting - where *retributive* names the paying back, this frames the same act as a claim made good.
members._gloss: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts

members.tone: Approval of the coldest kind - a warrant rather than a compliment, resting on validity where *conscionable* rests on conscience.
members._gloss: legally valid

families.axis: competence acknowledged → supreme mastery admired
families._definition: having or showing or requiring special skill

members.tone: Plain, checkable praise — it credits capability without admiring it, and can sit on the work that demands the skill as easily as on the person who has it.
members._gloss: having or showing or requiring special skill

members.tone: Praise with attainment behind it — skill brought to a high finish, warmer and more admiring than the flat *skilled*.
members._gloss: highly skilled

members.tone: Approves by totality rather than dazzle — it says nothing is missing from the skill, a cooler verdict than *accomplished*.
members._gloss: highly skilled

members.tone: Praise for deft, unlaboured sureness — it admires the aptitude in the doing where *expert* admires the knowing.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: The authoritative member: it grants knowledge that can be leaned on and vouched for, weightier and less warm than *good*.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: The mildest approval here — it concedes competence and stops, where *expert* confers standing.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: Credits skill that has been worked in until it is habitual, steadier and less brilliant than *virtuoso*.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: Measured, almost certifying approval — it reports that the standard is met, with none of the admiration in *masterful*.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: Approves the handling itself — visible dexterity in execution, more concrete than the standing implied by *expert*.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude

members.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the approving weight of *skillful* for deftness in execution.
members._gloss: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
used of a player skilled in stealing the ball or robbing a batter of a hit
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: Superlative praise — skill carried to its finish with nothing left to add, far above the workaday *proficient*.
members._gloss: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill

members.tone: Praise that hears authority in the skill — command of the craft, where *accomplished* only reports a high finish.
members._gloss: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill

members.tone: Admires mastery in the execution rather than in the person, the quieter of the pair beside *masterful*.
members._gloss: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill

members.tone: Praise pitched at display — mastery brilliant enough to be watched, showier than the sober *consummate*.
members._gloss: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill

members.tone: Praise for fineness of touch — skill admired for precision and restraint rather than the power heard in *masterful*.
members._gloss: marked by great skill especially in meticulous technique

families.axis: bare statement that a thing nourishes → warm praise of food that does you good and fills you up
families._definition: conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being

members.tone: Approval that reaches past the body to character - it can be aimed at a person's morals as readily as at a meal.
members._gloss: conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being

members.tone: Flat and clinical - it states that a thing feeds and stops there, with none of the approval in *nourishing*.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: The stiffer-sounding twin of *alimentary*, carrying the same neutral claim that something supplies nourishment.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: Warm where *alimentary* is clinical - the food is credited with doing the body good, not merely with feeding it.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: A bare classifier of what a substance supplies, passing no verdict on whether that is welcome.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: A quiet recommendation - it praises food for the good it delivers, where *nutrient* only labels it.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: Names the capacity to nourish rather than praising the food that has it - the technical member of the set.
members._gloss: of or providing nourishment

members.tone: Approval pinned to one measurable thing, and to what the food leaves out rather than what it supplies.
members._gloss: of foods that are low in fats and sodium and other ingredients that may foster heart disea

members.tone: Plain approval of a thing for the good it does, without the moral reach of *wholesome*.
members._gloss: promoting health; healthful

members.tone: Formal and slightly grand - the same claim as *healthy* pitched at a height the plainer word never reaches.
members._gloss: promoting health; healthful

members.tone: Informal and addressed to whoever benefits, which makes the good it names personal in a way *salubrious* never is.
members._gloss: promoting health; healthful

members.tone: Warm approval of abundance - the meal is praised for filling as well as feeding.
members._gloss: providing abundant nourishment

members.tone: Measures the abundance by its effect on the appetite rather than by the size of the plate.
members._gloss: providing abundant nourishment

members.tone: Sturdy and unshowy - the plenty is credited as substance rather than as generosity.
members._gloss: providing abundant nourishment

members.tone: Approval by fair measure - a full and proper portion rather than a lavish one.
members._gloss: providing abundant nourishment

members.tone: Weighs the meal by sheer bulk, a cooler judgement than *hearty* makes of the same plateful.
members._gloss: providing abundant nourishment

families.axis: neutral capacity to shape or structure → approving of what builds or restores to good condition
families._definition: constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development

members.tone: Approving on two counts at once - it builds and it improves, where *formative* only shapes and leaves the worth of the result open.
members._gloss: constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development

members.tone: Approving at one remove: it credits what fosters making rather than the making itself, a lighter claim than the improvement built into *constructive*.
members._gloss: promoting construction or creation

members.tone: Neutral - it names the power to shape without saying the shaping is for the better, which is exactly what *constructive* asserts.
members._gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning

members.tone: Bare and unweighted, the act of forming stated as such, where *formative* points instead at the capacity to form.
members._gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning

members.tone: Treats the power to mold as a flat property of a thing rather than a merit, which keeps it cooler than *creative*.
members._gloss: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning

members.tone: Carries no approval at all - it marks how something is arrived at, by interpretation rather than statement, where *constructive* judges the worth of what is done.
members._gloss: based on interpretation; not directly expressed

members.tone: Approving of repair: the good it names is a return to sound condition rather than the new making in *constructive*.
members._gloss: helping to restore to good condition

members.tone: The same restoring good as *reconstructive*, but the longer, more formal word makes the helping sound like a sustained process rather than a single fix.
members._gloss: helping to restore to good condition

members.tone: Purely descriptive - it places a thing within a system of study and does none of the approving that runs through *constructive*.
members._gloss: concerned with systematic structure in a particular field of study

families.axis: neutral record of an unworked state → shortfall measured against the state wanted
families._definition: not brought to the desired final state

members.tone: Carries a faint reproach because the thing is measured against the final state that was wanted, so it records a shortfall rather than merely a stage.
members._gloss: not brought to the desired final state
used of wood and furniture
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members._gloss: used of wood and furniture
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: Neutral about workmanship - the shaping has been done and only the finishing has not, where *unhewn* denies the shaping altogether.
members._gloss: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing

members.tone: Flatter and more matter-of-fact than *roughhewn*, naming the cut alone without that word's suggestion of ruggedly worked bulk.
members._gloss: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing

members.tone: Names one specific operation left undone rather than a general falling-short, which keeps it cooler and more technical than *unfinished*.
members._gloss: of lumber or stone or hides; not finished or dressed

members.tone: Coolly commercial disparagement - the animal is graded short of what the market wants, a deficiency stated as plain fact rather than complaint.
members._gloss: (of market animals) not optimal for marketing

families.axis: merely out of the ordinary → oddness that repels or frightens
families._definition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird

members.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.
members._gloss: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird

members.tone: The flat member of the pair - it records a departure from the expected without *strange*'s hint that something is amiss.
members._gloss: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird

members.tone: Odd to the point of being laughed at - the strangeness reads as clownish rather than menacing.
members._gloss: ludicrously odd

members.tone: Oddness inflated past what belief will carry, so the extravagance itself is the fault.
members._gloss: ludicrously odd

members.tone: The more elaborate twin of *fantastic* - the oddness sounds invented rather than merely met with.
members._gloss: ludicrously odd

members.tone: The harshest of these - the oddness is distorted enough to repel, where *antic* only invites laughter.
members._gloss: ludicrously odd

members.tone: Blunt and informal - it throws up its hands at the strangeness instead of examining it.
members._gloss: bizarre or fantastic

members.tone: The oddness is inviting - it asks to be looked into, where *queer* asks to be backed away from.
members._gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected

members.tone: Marks something as not quite right without saying what is wrong with it, and the vagueness is the unease.
members._gloss: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
